scientific_integrity: Proof gives exact rational matrix recurrence and its radical solution. Finite exact-arithmetic tests are supplementary only. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-spaced open quadratic B-spline coefficient recovery only; no claims for interpolant function norms, higher degrees or irregular knots. Historical priority remains provisional because the full 1983 Marsden paper was not inspected.
title: Sharp boundary amplification of clamped quadratic Greville coefficient recovery
